meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会逐个把代码库里的每个源文件完整读完，大文件用 Read 工具的 offset、limit 分页读完，不跳文件，以此建立对项目的理解。
howto.when: 当你开始接手一个新项目或不熟悉的代码库，或说出「learn the codebase」「prime」等说法时触发。

say.text: 帮我通读一遍这个代码库
say.note: 它会把每个源文件完整读完再回话

say.text: 我要开始改这个不熟的项目，先读完代码
say.note: 它按文件逐个读取，大文件分页读
它进入完整读取代码库的流程

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads every source file in the codebase in full, paging through large files with the Read tool's offset and limit parameters, to build understanding before working.
howto.when_en: Use when starting on a new or unfamiliar project, or when you ask to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.text: Read through this codebase for me
say_en.note: It reads every source file in full first

say_en.text: I'm starting work on an unfamiliar project, read the code first
say_en.note: It reads file by file, paging large ones
It starts the full codebase read-through
